name: statusline
description: ClaudeCodeStatusline as a function-hook mod: the status bar drawn in the hint line under the prompt, each segment revealing its details on hover, with /statusline-mod to pick the segments.

scheme.title: Colour scheme
scheme.description: Which palette paints the segments. mono paints nothing and dims every segment.

details.title: Hover details
details.description: Reveal the details of the segment under the mouse pointer on a card over the row above the bar. Needs the fullscreen terminal with mouse tracking.

pin_status.title: Pin a plain status line
pin_status.description: Also pin the bar as plain text under the prompt, where no hover is needed.
